target.title: fix(thinking): fall back instead of erroring on unsupported adaptive level (#109351)
target.body:
This is a focused, single-commit resubmission of the closed #111037 (which accidentally carried unrelated stacked commits). This branch touches ONLY the adaptive-thinking fix: 2 files, +46/-2.

## Summary

Messages from clients that send `thinking="adaptive"` as a transport default (e.g. the Apple Watch client) were rejected with `Thinking level "adaptive" is not supported for <provider>/<model>`, while the same message from the paired iOS app (which sends no override) succeeded.

`adaptive` is the **auto sentinel** — `normalizeThinkLevel` maps `"auto"` -> `"adaptive"`. It means *"pick an appropriate level"*, not *"force this exact level"*. So when a model does not support `adaptive`, the correct behavior is to fall back to a supported level, not hard-error.

## Fix

In `runPreparedReply` (`src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply-run.ts`), the unsupported-thinking-level guard no longer treats a resolved `adaptive` level as an explicit hard-error case, so it flows into the existing `resolveSupportedThinkingLevel` fallback. Explicit **concrete** levels (a real `/think xhigh` or one-turn `xhigh` override) still hard-error exactly as before.

```diff
   if (!thinkingLevelSupported) {
-    const explicitThink =
-      (directives.hasThinkDirective && directives.thinkLevel !== undefined) ||
-      explicitThinkingLevelOverride !== undefined;
+    const explicitThink =
+      resolvedThinkLevel !== "adaptive" &&
+      ((directives.hasThinkDirective && directives.thinkLevel !== undefined) ||
+        explicitThinkingLevelOverride !== undefined);
```

## Runtime proof (before / after)

Standalone repro against a gpt-5.6-sol-style model that does **not** support `adaptive`, exercising the real `isThinkingLevelSupported` / `resolveSupportedThinkingLevel` helpers and the exact guard predicate:

```
=== #109351 before/after proof (model=openai/gpt-5.6-sol, supports: no adaptive) ===

Apple Watch (thinking=adaptive):
  BEFORE fix: {"outcome":"ERROR","level":"adaptive"}   <- rejected (the bug)
  AFTER  fix: {"outcome":"run","level":"medium"}       <- falls back, reply succeeds
```

Behavior flow after the fix:
```
Apple Watch  ->  thinking=adaptive  ->  unsupported for model  ->  fall back to configured "medium"  ->  reply succeeds
```

## Tests

`vitest run --pool forks --reporter=verbose src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply-run.media-only.test.ts`:

```
 ✓ runPreparedReply media-only handling > reports unsupported explicit one-turn thinking overrides 6ms
 ✓ runPreparedReply media-only handling > falls back instead of erroring for an unsupported adaptive override (#109351) 9ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  101 passed (101)
```

- New regression test: an unsupported `adaptive` override falls back and runs the agent instead of erroring.
- Existing test `reports unsupported explicit one-turn thinking overrides` (concrete `xhigh`) still passes — explicit concrete levels remain hard errors.
- oxlint 0/0; oxfmt clean.

Closes #109351
